name: a green record on the same tree state is reused instead of re-run
prompt: The session file records: `verified: on a1b2c3d; build pass; tests pass`. The tree state is still a1b2c3d, and the change under review touches src/Orders/Cancel.cs only. You are the reviewer. Which checks do you run before writing the verdict, and why?
why: A verification result holds until the tree changes. Re-running a green suite on an unchanged tree is the single most expensive habit the instruction exists to stop.
